scope: Eight real Garage card selections, two cycles plus rapid convergence per tier; one fresh browser per run. Observational paired runs, not repeated statistical FPS or production-bundle certification.

runs.cache: Fresh browser; first cycle then repeat visits exceeding the pedestal cache; production prefetch remains enabled.
runs.build: Production UI paths served by the Vite development server; not a production-bundle timing test.
runs.timing: Pointerdown to observed UI/stage readiness; screenshot-completion upper bound on composited evidence. RAF gaps are callback intervals, not FPS.
